The '''Bilios system''' was in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Bilios]] was located in the system, and was once the site of a [[Justice Action Network]] base.<ref name="ES" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was located in the [[Melantha Province]], between the [[Cauper system/Legends|Cauper]] and the [[Shella system/Legends|Shella system]].<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
